sentence: This project studies how biopolymers, natural materials with bonding properties, let soil structures repair themselves after damage from moisture.
This project builds methods and hardware designs that make spiking neural networks easier to train and faster to run.
This project holds a workshop where cybersecurity researchers share ideas and discuss emerging topics.
This project develops mathematical tools that pull reliable information out of very large, noisy multidimensional datasets called tensors.
This project designs ways to send private information securely across wireless networks even when an eavesdropper intercepts transmissions over some of the links.
This project holds a workshop where researchers plan future research on intelligent cyber-physical systems and on keeping learning-enabled control systems safe.
This project develops a way to detect short-lived intermediates formed when per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances break down, using mass spectrometry.
This project builds a robotic system with touch-based sensing that lets robots handle objects and check their quality.
This project designs plant-inspired robots that monitor slowly and quickly changing environments for a long time.
This project builds a deep learning model that helps design composite materials with the mechanical properties wanted in several directions.
This project builds a virtual try-on system that makes a 3D body model from smartphone photos and simulates how clothing fits.
This project tests whether a soft wristband with strain sensors and machine learning can tell what the hand is doing.
This project builds quantum computing tools to analyze single-cell omics data and study how cells respond to drug combinations.
This project switches off genes for small peptides in Arabidopsis thaliana to find out how they affect plant growth and stress responses.
This project studies how camel spiders cope with heat by looking at stress-related proteins across different climates.
This project develops materials such as biomaterials that release drugs, thin films that generate ammonia and hydrogen, and quantum materials.
